facts.fact: President Barrow said in the 2025 State of the Nation Address that ID cards will be integrated with the Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system, passport and other databases into a unified digital ID system.

systems.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (ECRVS)

GMB.note: No count or share of people holding a national ID stated.

facts.fact: President Barrow said the unified digital ID system will be locally designed, built, operated and managed by government services to ensure knowledge transfer and ownership, and that the concession contract for the National ID system will soon be replaced.

GMB.note: Integration named is among identification databases; no public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: President Barrow said ID cards will be integrated with civil registration and passport databases to create a unified digital ID system, and that digitalisation of national documents is in progress.
President Barrow referred to the existing National ID system run under a concession contract that the government will soon replace.
